subject: Pre-Ordering Paradise
author: ZombieTron
body:
I had a quick search about and the release dates range from November 2007 - February 2008 for pre-orders in the UK. The price seems to be around £39.99. I do not see the benefit of pre-ordering this early, although it is exciting to know its kinda on its way to you!

In the US if you pre-order you get a bonus in-game car - Steel Wheels. And the price is $59.99 with a release date of January 2008. So, slightly more incentive to pre-order, but I really hope that all cars will be available to all regions.

All release dates are still tentative, but the Play.com date of 14/12/07 sounds good to me! :-)
